pages.text: A huge tree stood at the market's end. Its roots stretched into the water.
Bung pointed toward it. "Let us walk all the way there, Ddori."
The wooden walkway was long and narrow. Ddori walked very slowly.
Bung lifted Ddori onto the back. "I will carry you."
About ten steps later, Bung's legs shook.
Bung set Ddori down and sat with a plop. The big tree was still far away.
The sun hung low at the river's end. Bung could not take another step.
Grandpa lifted Ddori's hand and placed it in Bung's.
Ddori toddled on those little feet. Bung walked slowly behind.
Both reached the big tree. Ddori hugged it with both arms.
